stock.description: Zibuyu Group Limited, a China-based enterprise, operates within the cross-border e-commerce sector. The company's core business involves designing, marketing, and distributing its proprietary collection of clothing, footwear, and various other merchandise. These goods are sold to an international customer base through a combination of its own online storefronts and established third-party e-commerce marketplaces. Established in 2011, the company maintains its headquarters in Hangzhou, China.
